name: FIN-001 - Geo-Routing & Country Detection Framework
Description:
Implement Cloudflare header or IP-based detection to route users to localized landing pages. Expectation: A user in Kenya visiting konn3ct.com is seamlessly redirected to the Kenyan localized experience.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Middleware intercepts incoming traffic and reads 'CF-IPCountry' or MaxMind DB
- Routes user to `/ng`, `/ke`, `/za`, or `/global` based on location
- Sets user's default currency preference in cookie/local storage
- Allows manual country override via a footer dropdown

name: FIN-002 - Localized Landing Page Templates (Next.js)
Description:
Build the frontend Next.js templates for the country-specific landing pages (Volume 2). Expectation: High-converting, SEO-optimized pages.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Content Management architecture allowing different copy/testimonials per country
- Pricing tables dynamically reflecting local currencies (NGN, KES, ZAR, USD)
- Strict adherence to Core Web Vitals for fast loading (LCP < 2.5s)
- Next.js Server-Side Rendering (SSR) or Static Site Generation (SSG) for SEO

name: FIN-003 - Marketing Funnel Tracking & Analytics Sync
Description:
Integrate Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, and PostHog for granular funnel tracking. Expectation: Marketing teams can track CAC and conversion rates from WhatsApp ads to signups.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GTM data layer pushes events for 'Landing Page View', 'Signup Started', and 'Ticket Purchased'
- PostHog integration capturing anonymous-to-identified user journeys
- Privacy-compliant cookie consent banner implemented
- Clean UTM parameter extraction and storage in user's session

name: FIN-004 - Paystack & Flutterwave Integration
Description:
Integrate Paystack and/or Flutterwave APIs for West/East African payment processing. Expectation: Users can pay for webinars/subscriptions using local cards, bank transfers, and USSD.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Implementation of Paystack Popup / Flutterwave Checkout on the frontend
- Backend API routes to initialize transactions and fetch payment links
- Support for one-time webinar tickets and recurring monthly subscriptions
- Correct handling of NGN and GHS currencies

name: FIN-005 - M-Pesa Mobile Money Integration API
Description:
Integrate Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja API for frictionless mobile money payments in East Africa. Expectation: Kenyan users can purchase access via STK Push.

Acceptance Criteria:
- M-Pesa Express (STK Push) integration triggering a pin prompt on user's phone
- Background polling or webhook listener for M-Pesa transaction confirmation
- Error handling for timeouts, insufficient funds, or cancelled prompts
- Correct handling of KES currency

name: FIN-006 - PayGate Shield Webhook Verification (Critical)
Description:
Implement strict, cryptographically secure webhook endpoints to process payment successes (Volume 8). Expectation: Users cannot spoof client-side payment success to gain access.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Webhook endpoints verify HMAC SHA512/SHA256 signatures from Paystack/Stripe/M-Pesa
- Idempotent processing ensures a webhook fired twice doesn't double-provision access
- Never trusts client-side API calls claiming 'Payment Successful'
- Updates Database `Ticket` or `Subscription` status to 'PAID'

name: FIN-007 - Stripe Integration (International Tier)
Description:
Integrate Stripe Checkout for Rest-of-World (USD/EUR/GBP) transactions. Expectation: Global users have a standard card payment gateway.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Stripe Checkout Session initialization on the backend
- Handling of Stripe Webhooks (`checkout.session.completed`)
- Syncing Stripe Customer IDs to the Konn3ct database
- Proper handling of 3D Secure authentication flow

name: FIN-008 - Digital Ticketing & Receipt Generation
Description:
Generate and email digital PDF receipts and webinar tickets upon successful payment. Expectation: Professional post-purchase experience.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PDF generation service rendering ticket with QR Code, Event Name, and Date
- Email integration (SendGrid/Postmark) dispatching the receipt instantly
- Odoo 19 ERP webhook triggered to log the invoice for accounting (Volume 11)
- User dashboard updated to display 'Purchased Tickets'

name: FIN-009 - Paid Replay & Video Monetization Unlock
Description:
Link the payment success webhooks to the Replay Library video player. Expectation: Users cannot watch a paid replay until their transaction clears.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Video player component checks backend entitlement API before loading HLS stream
- Paywall overlay displayed on video player for unauthenticated or unpaid users
- Instant unlock mechanism via WebSocket pushing 'Access Granted' immediately after webhook fires
- Anti-sharing token generation to prevent users from sharing direct video URLs

name: FIN-010 - Currency Conversion & Pricing Engine
Description:
Build a dynamic pricing engine that fetches exchange rates or reads fixed localized pricing tiers. Expectation: A $10 ticket displays appropriately in NGN based on config.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Database schema supporting fixed localized pricing (e.g., $10 but fixed at 10,000 NGN)
- Fallback dynamic exchange rate fetching via API (e.g., OpenExchangeRates)
- Admin dashboard interface allowing Feranmi/Host to set custom prices per region
- Prevents VPN abuse by enforcing payment gateway currency alignment with geo-location
